explanation: I searched Mathlib for `expMeasure`. It appears only in Mathlib/Probability/Distributions/Exponential.lean. That file has the definition, `isProbabilityMeasure_expMeasure`, and CDF lemmas (`cdf_expMeasure_eq`, `cdf_expMeasure_eq_integral`, `cdf_expMeasure_eq_lintegral`). It has no statement about the upper tail `expMeasure 1 (Ici t)`. The library proves the t ≥ 0 case with its own `ExponentialTransfer.expMeasure_one_Ici`. Getting the result from the CDF lemmas would mean converting `Ici` to the complement of `Iio`, handling the atomless case and the ENNReal/real conversions, and splitting on the sign of t. That is more than one or two short lines.
